title: Introduction to Data Visualization with ggplot2
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of R programming language
learning_objectives: Understand the grammar of graphics and ggplot2's layered approach to visualization
Create common plot types (scatter plots, bar charts, histograms, etc.) using ggplot2
Customize plot aesthetics, themes, and annotations for effective scientific communication
Interpret and troubleshoot common visualization challenges
assumptions: Participants have R installed and basic data manipulation skills
Participants have access to a computer with internet connectivity
